The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 732c93a33db2c8c7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. statement: Let w1, . . . , wm ∈ G ∗ Fn have exponent-sum matrix of row rank m over Q. Let Σ be a connected oriented surface of genus zero obtained from a nonempty finite collection of signed word disks for these words by attaching bands that pair every slot exactly once, always with the same variable index and opposite traversal signs. If the words on all boundary components except possibly one are trivial in G, then every boundary word is trivial in G.
